1. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material __that is a thread locking adhesive__ on a threaded region of an opening in a multi-piece assembly; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of the opening to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the multi-piece assembly; and tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads __using tooling configured to precisely control application of the first coating material__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising adjusting the first friction interface independent of the second friction interface __by selectively varying an amount of the thread locking adhesive applied to the threaded region__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3, wherein adjusting the first friction interface includes adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region __using precision application tooling__, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface without affecting friction at the second friction interface.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid __comprising the thread locking adhesive__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising providing a second coating material __that is different from the thread locking adhesive__ at the second friction interface.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating.

11. (Previously presented) The method of claim 1, wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive.

12. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: applying a first coating material __that is a thread locking adhesive__ on a threaded region of an opening in a first multi-piece assembly included in plurality of multi-piece assemblies; inserting at least one fastener to the threaded region, the fastener including a mating thread selectively secured to the threaded region of __the opening__ to create a first friction interface between the fastener and the first multi-piece assembly, the fastener having a second coating material; tensioning the fastener between a load surface of the multi-piece assembly and a mating thread of the fastener to define a second friction interface between the multi-piece assembly and the fastener, the second friction interface being spaced away from the threaded region such that the first coating material does not influence the second friction interface; adjusting an amount of the first coating material applied to the threaded region in a subsequent multi-piece assembly __using precision application tooling__, thereby increasing friction at the first friction interface of the subsequent multi-piece assembly compared with the first multi-piece assembly, the friction at the second friction interfaces of the first multi-piece assembly and the subsequent multi-piece assembly being substantially equal.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising: establishing the multi-piece assemblies as connecting rods; wherein the first coating material is a thread locking adhesive and the second coating material includes a corrosion-resistant coating __that is different from the thread locking adhesive__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, further comprising establishing the first coating material as being applied solely within the opening and in a substantially uniform thickness upon the threads __using precision application tooling configured to control coating thickness__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12, wherein applying the first coating material includes filling the opening at least partially with a coating fluid __comprising the thread locking adhesive__.
